BiblicalUsage: Ziv is the name of the second month of the year, the month when Solomon began building the temple and the month when its foundation was laid. The temple rose in the springtime of Israel's story, and the month's name — brightness — fits a house built for the glory of God. Both of its appearances in Scripture mark the temple's beginning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the timing is no accident: God set His house's foundation in the bright month, and the work that began in Ziv would stand for centuries as the place where heaven met earth.
